steps.title: Prepare CSV input file
steps.instruction: Create a CSV file with header line: Plate number | Well | Concentration (ng/ul) | Diluent Volume (ul) | Sample volume (ul) | Total volume (ul) | Desired concentration (ng/ul). Fill rows for each well of up to three 96‑well plates.

steps.title: Set tiprack reset option
steps.instruction: Choose “yes” to start tip pickup at A1 on the 200 µL tip rack, or “no” to continue from the previous tip position.

steps.title: Choose pause inclusion
steps.instruction: Select “yes” to insert pause steps after diluent addition and between each source‑plate transfer; select “no” to run continuously.

steps.title: Mount pipettes
steps.instruction: Mount the P20 multi‑channel pipette on the specified mount (left or right) and the P300 single‑channel pipette on its specified mount (left or right).

steps.title: Add diluent to first destination plate
steps.instruction: Using the P300 single‑channel pipette, transfer X µL of dilution buffer from slot 11 to every well (up to 96) of the destination plate placed in slot 8. Volume X is taken from the CSV for each well.

steps.title: Pause and load first source plate
steps.instruction: If pauses are enabled, pause the protocol, then load the first input plate into slot 9.

steps.title: Transfer first sample and tip touch
steps.instruction: Transfer Y µL of sample from the source plate in slot 9 to the left side of each well in the destination plate in slot 8, then perform a tip‑touch to ensure full dispense. Y is taken from the CSV for each well.

steps.title: Pause and remove first output plate
steps.instruction: If pauses are enabled, pause the protocol and remove the destination plate from slot 8.

steps.title: Add diluent to second destination plate
steps.instruction: Using the P300 single‑channel pipette, transfer X µL of dilution buffer from slot 11 to every well (up to 96) of the destination plate placed in slot 5.

steps.title: Pause and load second source plate
steps.instruction: If pauses are enabled, pause the protocol, then load the second input plate into slot 6.

steps.title: Transfer second sample and tip touch
steps.instruction: Transfer Y µL of sample from the source plate in slot 6 to the left side of each well in the destination plate in slot 5, then perform a tip‑touch.

steps.title: Pause and remove second output plate
steps.instruction: If pauses are enabled, pause the protocol and remove the destination plate from slot 5.

steps.title: Add diluent to third destination plate
steps.instruction: Using the P300 single‑channel pipette, transfer X µL of dilution buffer from slot 11 to every well (up to 96) of the destination plate placed in slot 2.

steps.title: Pause and load third source plate
steps.instruction: If pauses are enabled, pause the protocol, then load the third input plate into slot 3.

steps.title: Transfer third sample and tip touch
steps.instruction: Transfer Y µL of sample from the source plate in slot 3 to the left side of each well in the destination plate in slot 2, then perform a tip‑touch.

steps.title: Pause and remove third output plate
steps.instruction: If pauses are enabled, pause the protocol and remove the destination plate from slot 2.
